## 6. No-Go Conditions

Record conditions under which ARM Agency should respectfully decline, pause, or redirect the opportunity. Examples include absent decision authority, unrealistic guarantees, prohibited data/access practices, no viable delivery capacity, or a mismatch between the requested work and the team’s bounded offers.
